heroHeadline: Trump Pledges Freedom for All Venezuelan Political Prisoners; Escalates '51st State' Drive
heroSubtitle: Trump told reporters May 12 he will secure release of all ~450 remaining Venezuelan detainees, while posting a Truth Social graphic showing the US flag over Venezuela labeled '51st State.' Acting President Rodríguez again rejected statehood. Americas Quarterly reports Rodríguez is pursuing 'normalization without transition' — complying just enough to preserve US goodwill while deferring democratic elections until Trump's leverage weakens.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN, OAS, IACHR, OFAC, Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera, NPR, Washington Post, Bloomberg, CNN, US News, Americas Quarterly, Efecto Cocuyo, Foro Penal, HRW, Amnesty International, ENCOVI, IMF, World Bank, Holland & Knight, Kaieteur News, Guyana Chronicle, and PDVSA official records.
